posts.title: Another 3 Month Update!
posts.description: I think RSS updates might come once every 3 months or so from now on since I don't get to update my site as much these days. Today's update brings 5 new images to my DGM gallery, a few new Links , and a brand new song for my homepage! As well as a bunch of new art in my DGM, Ososan, and Other NSFW Galleries . See you next time!

posts.title: 3 Month Update! New art!
posts.description: Apologies for the lack of updates! Been finding myself with little time to work on my site for some months now, but I was finally able to upload new stuff to my galleries. You'll find a bit of new art in the DGM , dotHack , and Shaman King sections. And there's a BUNCH of new art in all NSFW Galleries as well. Added a few LINKS as well. Hoping updates can be a little more frequent going forward.
